name: tencent-hunyuan/hy-simulmt
title: Tencent releases Hy-SimulMT 30B-A3B, open-weight simultaneous Chinese/English speech translation
summary: Tencent Hunyuan published Hy-SimulMT, a 30B MoE (3B active) model under Apache 2.0 that translates Chinese and English speech in both directions while the speaker is still talking, with voice cloning when paired with a TTS service. FP8, GGUF and interleaved variants are on Hugging Face, and the GitHub repo ships an inference service and training tools. Tencent reports about 3 s StreamLAAL latency
